Name: Joram, Son of Toi
Summary: Joram, son of Toi king of Hamath, was sent to David with vessels of silver, gold, and brass to salute him for defeating Hadadezer.
KeyStory: Joram carried his father's thank-offering to the king who had broken their common enemy.
RelatedPeople: Toi, King of Hamath; King David
LifeLesson: Gratitude carried by a son honours both fathers and kings.
